open.title: SHHS Dataset PyHealth 2.0 Migration
open.description: Move SHHSDataset off the legacy BaseSignalDataset onto the 2.0 BaseDataset (YAML config and processors) and ensure the sleep-staging task runs on it, using TUEV as the reference port. [code1](https://github.com/sunlabuiuc/PyHealth/blob/master/pyhealth/datasets/shhs.py), [code2](https://github.com/sunlabuiuc/PyHealth/blob/master/pyhealth/datasets/tuev.py)

open.title: Add YAIB Benchmarks into PyHealth
open.description: Port the YAIB (Yet Another ICU Benchmark) cohorts and tasks (mortality, AKI, sepsis, kidney function, and length of stay) so PyHealth models can be scored against YAIB baselines on MIMIC-IV and eICU. [code](https://github.com/rvandewater/yaib)

open.title: Awaken the Giant / GiantMed (KDD 2026)
open.description: Implement Awaken the Giant (GiantMed), a boundary-aware deep-model-guided LLM framework for medication recommendation on MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV.

open.title: LLM Code-Embedding Transfer (npj Digital Medicine 2026)
open.description: Add LLM-embedding transfer of EHR predictors across coding systems (such as OMOP/ICD to other vocabularies) for cross-coding-system clinical prediction. [code](https://github.com/mkirchler/grasp), [paper](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41746-026-02363-5)

open.title: RePrompT (ACL 2026)
open.description: Implement RePrompT (recurrent prompt tuning integrating structured EHR encoders with LLMs), along with RASPER and ARCI baselines, on MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV. [code](https://github.com/KU-AI4H/RePrompT), [paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.17725)

open.title: Context Clues Long-Context EHR Foundation Models (ICLR 2025)
open.description: Add long-context EHR foundation models (Mamba, Hyena, Llama, GPT) from Context Clues and evaluate them head-to-head against PyHealth's EHRMamba on EHRSHOT and OMOP. [code](https://github.com/som-shahlab/hf_ehr), [paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.16178)

open.title: FLAME (NeurIPS 2025)
open.description: Implement FLAME for fine-grained list-wise LLM medication recommendation on PyHealth's MIMIC-III/IV and eICU drug-recommendation tasks alongside SafeDrug, GAMENet, MICRON, and MoleRec. [code](https://github.com/cxfann/Flame), [paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.20218)

open.title: MIRA Medical Time-Series Foundation Model (NeurIPS 2025)
open.description: Integrate MIRA as a medical time-series foundation encoder for PyHealth ICU and biosignal tasks across MIMIC-III/IV, PhysioNet 2012, PTB-XL, and Sleep-EDF. [code](https://github.com/microsoft/MIRA), [paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.07584)

open.title: DiPro (NeurIPS 2025)
open.description: Implement DiPro for longitudinal EHR and sequential chest X-ray disease-progression modeling on MIMIC-IV and MIMIC-CXR. [code](https://github.com/Chenliu-svg/DiPro), [paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.11112)

open.title: APN Irregular Time-Series Forecasting (AAAI 2025)
open.description: Add APN as a simple baseline model alongside an irregular clinical time-series forecasting task on PhysioNet 2012 and MIMIC. [code](https://github.com/decisionintelligence/APN), [paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.11250)

open.title: ARMR (IJCAI 2025)
open.description: Implement ARMR (Adaptively Responsive Network) for PyHealth's MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV medication-recommendation tasks. [code](https://github.com/seucoin/armr2), [paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.04428)

open.title: FedWeight Cross-Site Federated EHR Benchmark (npj Digital Medicine 2025)
open.description: Add the FedWeight patient density-ratio re-weighting federated learning benchmark across hospital sites on eICU and MIMIC-III. [code](https://github.com/li-lab-mcgill/FedWeight), [paper](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41746-025-01661-8)

open.title: II-KEA (EMNLP 2025)
open.description: Implement II-KEA, a knowledge-enhanced agentic causal-discovery diagnosis predictor, for PyHealth's MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV tasks. [code](https://github.com/hanxiaoxue114/II-KEA_HealthcareAgent), [paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.16288)

open.title: NutriSighT Underfeeding Prediction Task (Nature Communications 2025)
open.description: Add the ICU underfeeding prediction task for ventilated patients on MIMIC-IV and AmsterdamUMCdb along with the NutriSighT transformer baseline. [code](https://github.com/mjangda3/NutriSighT), [paper](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-025-66200-1)

open.title: Diffmv Missing-View Diffusion (KDD 2025)
open.description: Implement Diffmv, a unified diffusion framework for multimodal EHR prediction with random missing views and view laziness on MIMIC-III/IV and eICU. [code](https://github.com/xmed-lab/MMHealth), [paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.16373)

open.title: APRICOT-M (Nature Communications 2025)
open.description: Implement the APRICOT-M state-space model and real-time ICU acuity and therapy-requirement prediction tasks on eICU and MIMIC-IV. [code](https://github.com/iheallab/apricotM), [paper](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-025-62121-1)

open.title: KnowRare (npj Digital Medicine 2025)
open.description: Implement the KnowRare domain-adaptation model and rare-condition ICU outcome tasks across MIMIC-III, MIMIC-IV, and eICU. [code](https://github.com/JasonZuu/KnowRare), [paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.06432)

open.title: LLMs as EHR Encoders (npj Digital Medicine 2025)
open.description: Add the LLM-embedding EHR encoder baseline (serialize EHR events, embed with an LLM, and fit a linear head) on EHRSHOT and MIMIC tasks. [code](https://github.com/stefanhgm/ehrshot-benchmark), [paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.17403)

open.title: MEME Pseudo-Notes EHR Model (npj Digital Medicine 2025)
open.description: Implement the MEME multiple-embedding model (EHR-to-pseudo-notes) and MIMIC-IV-ED disposition and decompensation tasks on MIMIC-IV and EHRSHOT. [code](https://github.com/Simonlee711/MEME), [paper](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41746-025-01777-x)

open.title: TRACE Intra-Visit Lab Nowcasting (WWW 2025)
open.description: Add the intra-visit lab-value nowcasting task on MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV along with the TRACE patient-trajectory encoder. [code](https://github.com/Amehi/TRACE), [paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.23072)

open.title: GAN PyHealth 2.0 Migration
open.description: Port pyhealth/models/gan.py to the PyHealth 2.0 BaseModel and SampleDataset API with unit tests and an example notebook. Coordinate with open PR #1303, which adds a MIMIC-III code-set mode. [code](https://github.com/sunlabuiuc/PyHealth/blob/master/pyhealth/models/gan.py)

open.title: VAE PyHealth 2.0 Migration
open.description: Port pyhealth/models/vae.py to the PyHealth 2.0 BaseModel and SampleDataset API so it trains through the standard Trainer, with unit tests and an example notebook. [code](https://github.com/sunlabuiuc/PyHealth/blob/master/pyhealth/models/vae.py)

open.title: ETHOS-ARES (GigaScience 2025)
open.description: Implement the ETHOS generative timeline model and MEDS-based hospital outcome tasks (mortality, ICU admission, readmission, and length of stay) on MIMIC-IV using PyHealth's MEDSDataset. [code](https://github.com/ipolharvard/ethos-ares), [paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.06124)

open.title: MedPatch (MLHC 2025)
open.description: Implement MedPatch confidence-guided multimodal fusion (EHR time series, CXR, and notes) on MIMIC-IV and MIMIC-CXR alongside MedFuse. [code](https://github.com/nyuad-cai/MedPatch), [paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.09182)

open.title: TrajSurv (MLHC 2025)
open.description: Implement the TrajSurv continuous-trajectory survival model and survival prediction tasks on MIMIC-III and eICU. [code](https://github.com/zengsihang/TrajSurv), [paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.00657)

open.title: MultimodalMIMIC (ICML 2023)
open.description: Add the irregular multimodal EHR model (time attention over irregularly sampled vitals/labs fused with clinical notes) for MIMIC-III in-hospital mortality and phenotyping. [code](https://github.com/XZhang97666/MultimodalMIMIC)

open.title: MEDFAIR Imaging Fairness Benchmark (ICLR 2023)
open.description: Add MEDFAIR's group fairness metrics, model-selection criteria, and debiasing baselines for PyHealth's medical imaging tasks. [code](https://github.com/ys-zong/MEDFAIR)

open.title: MIU-VL Medical Image VLMs (ICLR 2023)
open.description: Add prompt-based pretrained vision-language model baselines for medical image detection in PyHealth. [code](https://github.com/MembrAI/MIU-VL)

open.title: CEHR-GPT (arXiv 2024)
open.description: Implement the CEHR-GPT generative OMOP foundation model for synthetic patient timelines, building on PyHealth's existing CEHR embeddings and processor. [code](https://github.com/knatarajan-lab/cehrgpt), [paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.04400)

open.title: HiCu Curriculum ICD Coding (MLHC 2022)
open.description: Add HiCu curriculum learning over the ICD hierarchy to PyHealth's automated medical-coding task on MIMIC-III clinical notes. [code](https://github.com/wren93/HiCu-ICD)

open.title: GenoML Multimodal Parkinson's Classifier (npj Parkinson's Disease 2022)
open.description: Add the multimodal (genetics and clinical) Parkinson's disease classifier in PyHealth, noting that PPMI data access and a loader are required. [code](https://github.com/GenoML/GenoML_multimodal_PD)

open.title: Convolution Over Medical Entities (AI in Medicine 2021)
open.description: Implement the multimodal CNN over extracted medical entities combined with clinical time series for MIMIC-III mortality and length-of-stay prediction. [code](https://github.com/tanlab/ConvolutionMedicalNer)

open.title: Temporal Pointwise Convolution / TPC (CHIL 2021)
open.description: Implement the Temporal Pointwise Convolution (TPC) model for ICU length-of-stay and mortality prediction on eICU and MIMIC-IV. [code](https://github.com/EmmaRocheteau/TPC-LoS-prediction)

open.title: ICU Readmission Architecture Benchmark (Scientific Reports 2020)
open.description: Add the time-aware attention and sequence model baselines together with the ICU readmission benchmark on MIMIC-III. [code](https://github.com/sebbarb/time_aware_attention)

open.title: Clinical Fusion Structured + Notes Baselines (BMC MIDM 2020)
open.description: Add the structured-plus-unstructured clinical notes fusion baselines for MIMIC-III mortality, length of stay, and readmission prediction. [code](https://github.com/onlyzdd/clinical-fusion)

completed.title: Fair Conformal Predictors for Medical Imaging (AAAI 2022)
Joint Sequence and Image Irregular Time-Series Model (AAAI 2025)
